WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(length) as avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) as baseline_avg
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_above_baseline AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_length
  FROM rating_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN baseline_stats bs
  WHERE rs.avg_length > bs.baseline_avg
),
mean_of_above_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) as mean_above
  FROM filtered_above_baseline
),
final_filtered AS (
  SELECT fab.avg_length
  FROM filtered_above_baseline fab
  CROSS JOIN mean_of_above_baseline moab
  WHERE fab.avg_length > moab.mean_above
)
SELECT
  AVG(ff.avg_length) as mean_of_remaining,
  AVG(ff.avg_length - bs.baseline_avg) as mean_excess_over_baseline,
  AVG(ff.avg_length - moab.mean_above) as mean_excess_over_kept_mean
FROM final_filtered ff
CROSS JOIN baseline_stats bs
CROSS JOIN mean_of_above_baseline moab
